qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the M8 screw on the water pump to crankcase?
What size screw requires 10 Nm of torque for the water pump to crankcase connection?
What section of the manual covers the water pump and drive specifications?
How many different screw sizes are specified for the water pump to crankcase mounting?
qa_pairs.answer: Two different screw sizes - M8 and M6

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between the M8 and M6 screws for the water pump mounting?
qa_pairs.answer: The difference is 12 Nm (M8 at 22 Nm minus M6 at 10 Nm)

qa_pairs.question: Do these torque specifications apply to all vehicle types?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, both specifications show 'All' in the Type column

qa_pairs.question: What component is being fastened with these torque specifications?
What unit of measurement is used for all the torque specifications on this page?
Which screw size requires more than double the torque of the other when mounting the water pump?
qa_pairs.answer: The M8 screw requires 22 Nm, which is more than double the 10 Nm required for the M6 screw
